<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get an exception case"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/exceptions/{caseId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the case with its frozen source payload, its SLA clock, its
occurrence count, its assignee and resolution once they exist, and the
audit trail (one entry per transition, each with its actor).

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>
